Alex’s day unfolded with a steady rhythm, marked by moderate task variety and manageable interruptions that kept his conscientiousness engaged but not overwhelmed. Despite screen fatigue and social energy drain, Alex navigated the day’s demands with measured resilience, finishing neither depleted nor invigorated—just the typical texture of his work life.
